description: This file defines an Android activity class 'LayoutAnimation4' which displays a grid of app icons loaded via package manager queries. It uses views, adapters, and resolve info to dynamically populate a grid layout with icons for launchable applications.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation4
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a grid of icons from launchable apps.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads app list, and sets up the grid view with an adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the package manager for launchable activities and stores them in mApps.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for populating the grid view with app icons.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns an ImageView for the app icon at a given position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display, capped at 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object for a given position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
